name: Nuki-chan
source:
Nuki-chan is a shy bookworm who is easily startled by acts of attempted rape, which you think she’d have gotten used to by now, what with being a Japanese schoolgirl and all. Her favorite book is Grean Eggz an Hamz by the Japanese literary genius Dr. Soup. She hides her face behind her hair because she has low self esteem and thinks she is ugly and fat, yet the details of her face are still visible due to the magical properties of animess hair. She may seem hostile to her peers, but she is just socially retarded and looking for a kawaii prince charming to sweep her off her feet. Could Chichi-chan be that special man? Nuki-chan kawaii!!

[From [url=http://animerand.blogspot.com/2009/05/this-is-development-blog-for-visual.html]Official Site[/url]]
